body:
I agree there is a gap in the spec which is worth fixing, but testing this on my mac, `lastModified` is modified as one would expect on all browsers (Firefox, Safari, Chrome).

There is actually [a WPT test](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/blob/master/fs/script-tests/FileSystemFileHandle-getFile.js#L13) which covers this: [it creates a file](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/blob/master/fs/script-tests/FileSystemFileHandle-getFile.js#L14), using [`getFileHandle`](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/blob/master/fs/resources/test-helpers.js#L67), [writes](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/blob/master/fs/script-tests/FileSystemFileHandle-getFile.js#L27), and [compare both timestamps](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/blob/master/fs/script-tests/FileSystemFileHandle-getFile.js#L42).

The only case where I could reproduce the issue you reported is on Chrome using private browsing mode (OPFS is not available on Safari and Firefox). When using `createSyncAccessHandle` like in your test. When using something similar to what WPT does, I don't have the issue.
